name: GitJournal
description: Journal de travail Git — Bureau Tauri/Rust et CLI JavaScript

scripts.test:rust: node scripts/build-desktop.mjs && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/journal-core/Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:parity: cargo build --locked --manifest-path crates/journal-core/Cargo.toml --example snapshot && node scripts/check-parity.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm test && pnpm test:rust && pnpm desktop:build
scripts.build:linux: pnpm test && pnpm test:rust && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs linux
scripts.build:mac: pnpm test && pnpm test:rust && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs darwin
scripts.build:win: pnpm test && pnpm test:rust && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs && node scripts/build-native.mjs win32
